neighbours.label: The copula or operator that introduces the computed result in a worked calculation ('so the distance is', '= ', '/2'), vs the same verbs introducing non-numeric conclusions
fire: The car covers 120 km in 2 hours, so the average speed is 60 km per hour.
Each box holds 12 eggs and we have 5 boxes, so the total number of eggs is 60.
The rectangle is 4 m wide and 3 m long, so its area is 12 square meters.
Light takes 8 minutes to arrive, so the distance to the Sun is about 150 million km.
The echo returns after 2 seconds, so the depth of the well is roughly 340 m.
Half of the 30 students passed, so the number who failed is 15.
The tank loses 3 litres per hour, so after 4 hours the loss is 12 litres.
The voltage is 12 V and the resistance is 4 ohms, so the current is 3 A.
quiet: The car is red and has leather seats, so the owner is very proud of it.
Each box was wrapped in paper and tied with string before the party.
The rectangle is a common shape in architecture and in modern furniture.
Light from the Sun warms the Earth and makes plants grow in spring.
The echo in the cave was loud, so the children shouted their names again.
Half of the students passed, and their parents were happy with the news.
The tank was painted green and stood in the corner of the farmyard.
The old radio was broken, so the repairman took it back to his shop.

predictions: The ' is' or operator right before a worked numeric answer reaches 0.3-0.7; ' is' before a plain description stays under 0.15.
notes: Card: peaks on '/' in 3,43/2, ' ' before digits in 'The Answer of 1 + 1 is 2.0', 'her 86 years', 'adds 1', '(' in AddSpacer(5). Probe: 'so the distance is 340/2' 0.682 at ' is', but 'so the distance is half the total path' also 0.682 at ' is' (the frame 'so the X is' fires before the result appears); 'answer to 3 + 4 is 7' 0.058, '86 years' 0.016, 'adds 1' 0.102. So the label is the frame that sets up a derived quantity, not the digit.
